flags.detail: 4 employers in 5 years (2018–2024). Shortest tenure was 7 months at QuantumLeap Analytics. While one departure was due to layoffs (Orion Digital) and the early career period involved contract work, the pattern may indicate a flight risk.
flags.recommendation: Discuss career trajectory and what the candidate is looking for in terms of long-term growth. Verify layoff claim with Orion Digital HR if possible.

flags.detail: ~2 years (2018–2020) spent in IT support and freelance web development before transitioning to software engineering. Not unusual for self-taught developers, but may result in weaker foundational CS knowledge compared to peers.
flags.recommendation: Include algorithmic/systems design questions in the technical interview to assess foundational depth.
